name: aclymate
description: Estimate your business's carbon footprint, look up emission factors, understand GHG Protocol scopes, and benchmark against industry peers — powered by Aclymate.
long_description: Aclymate is the carbon accounting platform built for small and mid-sized businesses. This extension brings Aclymate's SMB carbon accounting data directly into Claude — estimate Scope 1/2/3 footprints by industry and size, look up emission factors with source citations, explain GHG Protocol scopes for any industry, and benchmark a company's emissions against peers. Powered by Aclymate's Climate Brain knowledge system.

tools.name: estimate_emissions
tools.title: Estimate Business Carbon Footprint
tools.description: Estimate the annual carbon footprint (tCO2e) for a business — returns a Scope 1/2/3 breakdown and biggest emission drivers as structured envelope fields

tools.name: explain_scope
tools.title: Explain GHG Protocol Scope
tools.description: Explain GHG Protocol Scope 1, 2, or 3 emissions in the context of a specific industry — returns Aclymate-voiced explanation with confidence and source metadata

tools.name: get_emission_factor
tools.title: Look Up Emission Factor
tools.description: Look up the emission factor for a specific activity — returns a structured value/source block on canonical hit, Climate Brain fallback on miss

tools.name: compare_business_footprint
tools.title: Benchmark Business Footprint
tools.description: Benchmark a company's carbon footprint against industry peers — returns a structured envelope with range, comparison, and top-performer patterns

tools.name: lookup_factor_by_id
tools.title: Look Up Emission Factor by ID
tools.description: Deterministic exact-match lookup of an emission factor by its canonical `factor_id`. Use search_factors first if the id isn't in hand.

tools.name: find_factor
tools.title: Find Emission Factor by Keys
tools.description: Keyed lookup — returns the first factor matching a `factor_type` + `keys` combination. Assertion mode; empty or unknown keys return null + a descriptive warning.

tools.name: search_factors
tools.title: Search Emission Factors
tools.description: Keyword search across the factor catalog — matches ids, categories, aliases, and search terms. Capped at 25 results with truncation warning.

tools.name: list_factor_types
tools.title: List Emission Factor Types
tools.description: List every emission factor type in Aclymate's canonical catalog. Use before find_factor to enumerate categories.

tools.name: list_factor_key_values
tools.title: List Emission Factor Key Values
tools.description: Enumerate the distinct values available for a given key under a factor type (e.g. every eGRID region). Omit key_name to use the type's designated drill key.

tools.name: calculate_flight_emissions
tools.title: Calculate Flight Emissions
tools.description: Calculate tCO2e for a flight using Aclymate's DEFRA-based factors — accepts distance in km, coordinate pairs, or defaults to NYC↔LA

tools.name: calculate_train_emissions
tools.title: Calculate Train Emissions
tools.description: Calculate tCO2e for a passenger train trip — light rail, regional rail, intercity rail, or Northeast Corridor

tools.name: calculate_other_transport_emissions
tools.title: Calculate Other Transport Emissions
tools.description: Calculate tCO2e for bus, rail, carpool, or walk/bike travel — closed enum with no silent zero for unknown types

tools.name: calculate_electricity_emissions
tools.title: Calculate Electricity Emissions
tools.description: Calculate tCO2e for electricity usage using EPA eGRID (US), Environment Canada province factors, or the IEA global average

tools.name: calculate_gas_emissions
tools.title: Calculate Gas Emissions
tools.description: Calculate tCO2e for natural gas, propane, heating oil, or wood combustion — fuel/unit pairs validated at parse time

tools.name: calculate_diet_emissions
tools.title: Calculate Diet Emissions
tools.description: Calculate monthly and annual tCO2e for a diet type (SAD or Healthy American Diet tiers 1–3) across N people

tools.name: calculate_pet_emissions
tools.title: Calculate Pet Emissions
tools.description: Calculate monthly and annual tCO2e for pets — dogs, cats, and large dogs (counted at 2× the dog factor)

tools.name: recommend_emissions_reductions
tools.title: Recommend Emissions Reductions
tools.description: Get 3-6 opinionated, industry-specific carbon-reduction levers for a business — each with a targeted scope, impact and effort rating, and a concrete first step, as structured envelope fields
